critical_code_review_comments: Additive-only change verified: no existing testid removed, no existing key removed. Only 4 new backend keys + 1 new frontend UI block (with 4 nested testids: storage-quota / storage-quota-pct / storage-quota-bar / and conditional storage-quota-warn|upgrade).

Backend server.py L296 sets license_label='Sistem' when admin, 'Ücretsiz' as fallback when non-admin & no license — matches spec ('If ahmet has no active license in the DB, the endpoint should still return quota_mb=50 (FREE_QUOTA_MB) and license_label='Ücretsiz').
Frontend NeuralLinkHeader.jsx L129 guards with `stats && !stats.is_admin_scope && stats.quota_mb` — safe against null; admin (quota_mb=null → falsy) correctly skipped.

Cosmetic note: line 158 uses stats.db_mb.toFixed(2) directly — if backend ever returned db_mb as int rather than float, toFixed would still work; if null it would crash. Not a real risk since backend guarantees db_mb is a rounded float, but a defensive Number(stats.db_mb || 0) would match L117 style. Non-blocking.
hud-text CSS uppercases the label so 'Deneme (30 gün)' becomes 'DENEME (30 GÜN)' in the UI — matches acceptance criterion; small legibility win vs pre-uppercasing on the backend.

Test suite: parallel xdist workers cause 401s because each worker does its own login and the newer login kicks the older token (single-session rule from Faz 5). Fix (used): run pytest with `-o addopts=''` to disable xdist parallelism for this file, or use scope='session' + retry. Documented for next agent.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Storage Quota bar (iteration_39) is a purely additive enhancement to iteration_38's refactor. Backend /api/stats/summary now returns 14 keys (10 legacy + 4 new: quota_mb, quota_percent, license_type, license_label). Admin bypass: quota_mb=null; user gets 100 (trial) / 500 (monthly) / 2048 (yearly) / 10240 (lifetime) / 50 (free/no license). Frontend NeuralLinkHeader.jsx renders the bar as an IIFE block after stat-db-size, guarded by `stats && !stats.is_admin_scope && stats.quota_mb`. Testids to expect: storage-quota (wrapper), storage-quota-pct (numeric label), storage-quota-bar (colored fill div with inline width%). Conditional: storage-quota-warn (75<=pct<90) and storage-quota-upgrade (pct>=90) — currently 0.0% for ahmet so neither renders. Color ramp: bg-sertex-cyan (<75) → bg-amber-400 (75-90) → bg-sertex-danger (>=90). To test the amber/red ramp you'd need to upload files until db_mb approaches 75/100 or 90/100 MB — not covered here since ahmet is at 0.02/100 MB (0.0%). Pytest tip: run test_stats_summary.py with `-o addopts=''` to bypass xdist parallelism (which triggers single-session-kick 401s across workers).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — clean acceptance test pass. Only agent-side test fix: existing test_stats_summary.py used xdist parallelism and after adding 4 new tests, 2 workers each did their own login, kicking each other's token via single-session rule → 3 spurious 401s. Fixed by running serial (-o addopts='') which is how it was run for the final green 10/10.
